statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = (z + 6)\vec k through a square of side 5 in the xy-plane, oriented in the negative z-direction.

static.solution: S, is in the plane z=0 and oriented in the negative z-direction, d\vec A=-\vec k dx\, dy and \int_S\vec F\cdot d\vec A=\int_S(0+6)\vec k\cdot (-\vec k dx \,dy)=-6\int_S dx\, dy = -6\cdot \mbox{Area of square }= -6(5^2) = -150.
